name: Grocery & Supermarket (multi-category mart)
shopper_profile: Repeat, task-driven shoppers filling a basket of many low-cost items quickly, often on mobile, who care about availability, delivery slots and price per unit.

catalog_traits.price_range: very low to low (under $1 to ~$50), basket-driven AOV

must_have_sections.name: Delivery/announcement bar
must_have_sections.why: Communicates delivery zones, cut-off times and free-delivery threshold

must_have_sections.name: Header with prominent predictive search
must_have_sections.why: Large catalogs are navigated by search first

must_have_sections.name: Department mega menu / category sidebar
must_have_sections.why: Dozens of aisles need a scannable hierarchy

must_have_sections.name: Promotional hero carousel
must_have_sections.why: Weekly offers and seasonal campaigns rotate frequently

must_have_sections.name: Shop-by-aisle icon grid
must_have_sections.why: Fast entry into departments with visual tiles

must_have_sections.name: Tabbed product carousels (deals, bestsellers, new)
must_have_sections.why: Dense merchandising of many SKUs above the fold

must_have_sections.name: Deal of the day with countdown
Multi-banner promo grid
must_have_sections.why: Brand and category offers side by side

must_have_sections.name: Shop by brand strip
must_have_sections.why: Many shoppers are brand-loyal for staples

must_have_sections.name: Product card with quick add / qty stepper
must_have_sections.why: Add without leaving the listing; essential for basket building

must_have_sections.name: Faceted filters + sort
must_have_sections.why: Diet, brand, price, size filtering in large aisles

must_have_sections.name: Service USP row (fresh, fast, secure)
must_have_sections.why: Sets expectations on freshness and delivery

must_have_sections.name: Sticky mobile bottom navigation
must_have_sections.why: Thumb access to categories, search, cart

collection_page_elements: Sidebar or drawer facets (brand, diet, price, size)
Compact dense grid (4-6 cols desktop, 2 mobile)
Quick add with qty stepper on cards

design_patterns.typography: Highly legible sans-serif, compact sizes, bold prices
design_patterns.color_mood: Fresh greens/oranges on white, strong sale red/yellow accents
design_patterns.imagery: Packshots on white, consistent square crops; lifestyle only in banners
design_patterns.layout: Dense, boxed, multi-column; utility-first like marketplace sites
design_patterns.motion: Minimal; quick cart feedback and carousel swipes only

conversion_drivers: Quick add and quantity steppers everywhere
Fast predictive search with product results

competitor_references.notable: Built for large catalogs: mega menu, quick buy, dense grids
Colorful food-focused preset with shop-by-category emphasis
Department sidebars, deal countdowns, brand strips

anti_patterns: Large editorial hero images pushing products below the fold
Forcing product page visits to add to cart
